name: ai_property_dialog_on_destroy
description: AiPropertyDlg::OnDestroy saves both combo-box item-data selections and hides the cursor after CWnd::OnDestroy.
known_limits: Functional smoke patches MFC42 CWnd::OnDestroy plus USER32 SendMessageA and ShowCursor, then verifies the original call order, CB_GETCURSEL/CB_GETITEMDATA arguments, stored property/behavior item data, and ShowCursor(FALSE).

After the source-faithful CComboBox layout correction, VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 profile sweep over valid /MD MFC-capable profiles still leaves 18 unmasked byte mismatches because VC5 schedules the m_selectedPropertyIndex store after the next behavior-combo HWND load/push sequence, while the original stores immediately after CB_GETITEMDATA.
